facts.fact: 毒蘑菇清除后草场重新开花。
facts.anchor: Flowers have taken over where the mushrooms used to be.

facts.fact: 国王倒台后全镇上山清蘑菇。
facts.anchor: Everyone pitched in to remove every last mushroom from the mountain.

facts.fact: 许多畸形幼龙戴上定做义翅。
facts.anchor: Most of them wear prosthetics—each one custom built to fit them.

facts.fact: Maple 翻山而来，飞得更高更稳。
facts.anchor: Maple comes soaring over the trees

facts.fact: 数月前放归 Maple 是艰难但正确的决定。
facts.anchor: It was difficult to release her months ago, but we both knew it was the right thing to do.

facts.fact: 两人承诺守望 Maple 的生活。
facts.anchor: But Micah and I will always be here.

facts.fact: Lucan 搬进 Micah 的小屋，把楼上公寓出租。
facts.anchor: Now that I’ve moved into Micah’s cottage

facts.fact: Lucan 买来生金准备打戒指。
facts.anchor: a large piece of raw gold. It wasn’t cheap

facts.fact: 尾声以求婚戒指收束，The End。
facts.anchor: I begin crafting the most important piece of metal I’ve ever forged…
